portrait.jpg: the face the Windows picture check tests build their video clips from
(tests/picture_check_windows.rs). The clips are made at test time; no video is stored here.

Source: NASA Image and Video Library, image S92-40463 (July 1992), "Official portrait of STS-47
Mission Specialist Mae C. Jemison in LES", NASA Johnson Space Center.
https://images.nasa.gov/details/S92-40463
File used: https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/S92-40463/S92-40463~small.jpg (512 x 640),
cropped to head and shoulders (300 x 330 from x 145, y 10) and scaled to 262 x 288.

License: public domain. The photo is a work of the United States government (NASA), which is not
subject to copyright in the United States (17 U.S.C. section 105). Wikimedia Commons lists the same
image as public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mae_Carol_Jemison.jpg
NASA's media usage guidelines (https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/) ask that
images of identifiable people are not used to imply endorsement; this file is used only to test
face detection.
